guide.title: How to use Membership Cards
guide.subtitle: A quick guide to signing in, adding your cards, and adding the app to your phone.
guide.step1.title: 1. Sign in
guide.step1.body: Open the link, then enter your name and phone number. There's no password to remember — your phone number is what identifies you, and it's also saved as your first card automatically, since most Norwegian stores can look up membership by phone number.
guide.step2.title: 2. Add your membership cards
guide.step2.body: Tap "+ Add card", pick the store, and type in your membership number (or just use your phone number if that's what the store uses). Give it a short name if you like, then save. Add as many cards as you want.
guide.step3.title: 3. Add it to your Home Screen
guide.step3.body: This turns the page into an app icon on your phone, so you can open it with one tap, no browser address bar needed.
guide.step3.iosIntro: Open the link in Safari (not Chrome), then:
guide.step3.iosTapShare: Tap the Share icon in the toolbar.
guide.step3.iosTapAdd: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
guide.step3.androidIntro: Open the link in Chrome, then:
guide.step3.androidTapMenu: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right.
guide.tip.title: Tip: quick scan at checkout
guide.tip.body: Tap any card in your list to show its barcode or QR code full-screen, ready for the cashier to scan.
